mechanism: Carisoprodol is metabolized to meprobamate which has CNS depressant effects; combined with metformin's potential to cause lactic acidosis in renal impairment, there is additive risk if carisoprodol-induced sedation masks symptoms of metabolic complications.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation and metabolic signs; ensure adequate renal function monitoring; use carisoprodol cautiously in patients with renal impairment or those at risk for lactic acidosis.
